sources.title: DeepFashion Image Classification - GitHub
sources.snippet: DeepFashion Image Classification is a neural network project focused on classifying clothing items from the DeepFashion dataset. This repository provides tools and models for recognizing clothing categories in images, supporting research and applications in fashion recognition, e-commerce, and computer vision.
